data.name: Awakening of Darkness: Build, Survive and Defend
data.detailed_description:
🌞 Build by Day. Survive by Night.

Awakening of Darkness is a 2D top-down survival strategy game that combines city building, tower defense, and roguelike elements into a tense and immersive experience. During the day, gather resources, build your village, and prepare your defenses. When night falls, waves of terrifying creatures rise from the darkness — and only your planning will keep you alive.

🏗️ City Building & Resource Management

Days are calm but limited. You’ll use this precious time to expand your settlement, assign villagers to gather essential materials, and construct buildings that ensure both productivity and protection.

From lumberyards and stone quarries to advanced production and defensive structures, every decision impacts your chances of surviving the night. The better you manage your time and resources, the stronger your village becomes.

🌑 Intense Night Defense

When the sun sets, danger begins. Nightfall brings escalating waves of monstrous enemies, forcing you to rely on your preparation and tactical decisions.

Build and position towers, place traps, and adapt your strategy in real-time. Each night grows more difficult, with deadlier creatures and evolving attack patterns. There's no pause — only reaction.

🔁 Roguelike Replayability

No two playthroughs are the same.
Each run begins on a procedurally generated map with randomized resources and enemy types. You’ll need to adapt your strategy based on what the world gives you.

Failing is part of the loop — but every defeat helps you learn, and through a permanent upgrade system, you'll return stronger and wiser each time.

📈 Persistent Progression

Even when your village falls, your journey doesn’t end.
Unlock global upgrades that improve your odds in future runs: better structures, faster resource gathering, stronger defenses, and more.

Progress is earned, not given — and every hard-earned upgrade feels meaningful.

🧠 Strategic Depth, Real-Time Decisions

Awakening of Darkness rewards players who can think fast and plan ahead.
Where you place your towers, how you assign your villagers, and how you spend your limited time and resources will all determine your fate. Do you focus on economy or defense? Expand or reinforce? Each choice matters.

⚔️ Will You Survive the Darkness?

Every run is a story of tension, hope, and inevitable confrontation.
You will lose. You will rebuild.
And with each attempt, you will come closer to mastering the balance between creation and survival.

The darkness awakens.
How long can you hold the light?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or equivalent (2GB VRAM, DirectX 11 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
